name: record-wizard-01
title: Record Wizard 01 - The Multi-Step Write Form
description: The multi-step record write form: one group of fields at a time above the shipped rail, driven entirely by the consumer's controlled step index and controlled values. It renders no back control, no forward control and no rail of its own, declares no submission arm of its own, and leaves an issue naming a key off the current step undrawn.
